extras.textures: PBR 2048px: base color, roughness, metallic, normal (baked)
extras.real_size: retro moped (50 cc), approx. 1.9 x 0.7 x 1.3 m (L x W x H, incl. rack and mirror), 17 in spoked wheels
extras.notes: front faces -Y; stands upright on its center stand; wheels are separate objects with origin on the axle (rotate around local X to roll); moped_steering (telescopic fork, handlebar, headlight, round speedometer with tick scale only, mirror, front fender) has its origin on the steering axis, tilted 26 deg: rotate around (0, 0.438, 0.899) in Blender Z-up = (0, 0.899, -0.438) in glTF Y-up; moped_crank (pedal arms, sprocket, rubber pedals) has its origin in the crank axle, rotate around local X; blank plate; no brand, no text

origin.detail: Built procedurally with Blender scripts. The scripts were written with the help of an AI coding assistant. No generative AI model produced the geometry or textures directly.
